name: A MIP Timing Detector for the CMS Phase-2 Upgrade
notes: Date taken from the CERN-LHCC report number year; the INSPIRE query returned no imprint date.

summary.plain: The plan for a new layer that times particles to a few tens of trillionths of a second, so CMS can tell apart the many collisions happening at once.
summary.technical: Phase-2 MIP timing detector TDR: barrel timing layer (LYSO:Ce + SiPM) and endcap timing layer (LGAD), ~30-40 ps resolution.
